description: \(H_{\aleph_1}\) is a proper subset of \(V_{\omega_1}\): \(\omega\) belongs to \(H_{\aleph_1}\) but its power set does not, although that power set has rank \(\omega+1\) and belongs to \(V_{\omega_1}\).
